entries.answer: It starts once you hold the FOG, STORM, MINERAL and GLACIER BADGES. The fake director on the top floor drops the BASEMENT KEY; it opens a door in the GOLDENROD TUNNEL, where the real director gives you the CARD KEY for the tower's third floor.
entries.title: TEAM ROCKET took the RADIO TOWER

entries.answer: Both clear once TEAM ROCKET is out of the RADIO TOWER.

entries.answer: After the RISING BADGE, see PROF. ELM, then go to ECRUTEAK, get the CLEAR BELL in the DANCE THEATER and face HO-OH on the roof of the BELL TOWER. The road to the LEAGUE opens after that.

entries.answer: Beat BLUE in VIRIDIAN CITY, then see PROF. OAK in PALLET TOWN: he gives you ROCK CLIMB and has the guard at the LEAGUE's gate let you through to ROUTE 28.
